The OIG data set does not include scheduled inspection dates. The dashboard notes that inspection timing is not recorded, and the latest dataset (as of 2026‑11‑04) contains no “next inspection” information for any facility, including the VA El Paso Healthcare System. Therefore, the OIG has not published a due date for the next inspection of the VA El Paso Healthcare System.

I understand that the OIG data doesn’t have the next inspection date. Could you let me know where I might find the scheduled inspection information for the VA El Paso Healthcare System, or suggest another source?

The OIG’s public data‑dashboard (the source of the vaoig_* tools) does not publish the dates on which a particular VA facility is scheduled for its next OIG inspection.  The OIG’s website also does not provide a searchable calendar of upcoming inspections; those dates are typically kept internal until the inspection is announced or completed.

**Where you can look for the scheduled inspection date**

| Source | How to access it | What you’ll find |
|--------|------------------|------------------|
| **VA Office of Inspector General (OIG) – “Inspection Schedule” page** | Visit the OIG’s public website ( https://www.vaoig.gov ) and look for a link titled **“Inspection Schedule”** or **“Upcoming Inspections.”**  If the page exists, it will list the fiscal year, VISN, and facility (by station number) for upcoming inspections.  If the page is not present, the OIG may provide the schedule only on request. |
| **VA Office of Inspector General – Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request** | Submit a FOIA request to the OIG asking for “the inspection schedule for VA El Paso Healthcare System (Station 657) for the current fiscal year.”  The OIG’s FOIA office can be contacted via https://www.vaoig.gov/foia or by emailing foia@vaoig.gov.  The response should include the planned inspection dates (or a statement that the dates are not yet set). |
| **VA Office of Inspector General – Contact the OIG directly** | Call the OIG’s public liaison office at **1‑800‑827‑1000** (press 1 for “OIG inquiries”).  Ask the representative for the scheduled inspection date for the El Paso VA Healthcare System.  They can either give you the date or direct you to the appropriate office that maintains the schedule. |
| **VA Office of the Secretary – Regional VISN Office** | The VISN that includes El Paso is **VISN 19**.  Contact the VISN‑19 Office of the Secretary (or its Inspection Coordination office) to ask about the OIG inspection timetable for the El Paso facility.  VISN‑19 contact information is listed on https://www.va.gov/visn19/ or you can call the VISN‑19 main line at 1‑888‑877‑3323. |
| **VA Facility‑Level “Office of Quality and Safety” or “Chief of Staff”** | Some VA medical centers publish internal inspection calendars on their own intranet or on public “Quality & Safety” web pages.  Visit the El Paso VA Healthcare System’s official site ( https://www.elpasova.gov  ) and look for sections such as **“Quality & Safety,” “Inspections,”** or **“Office of Inspector General.”**  If the information isn’t posted, you can email the facility’s public affairs office (often listed under “Contact Us”) and request the upcoming OIG inspection date. |
| **VA Office of Inspector General – Annual “Inspection Report” PDFs** | Each completed inspection results in a report (e.g., “Comprehensive Healthcare Inspection Program – El Paso VA – FY 2025”).  Those PDFs often contain a statement like “The next comprehensive inspection is scheduled for FY 2026.”  You can search the OIG’s report repository ( https://www.vaoig.gov/reports  ) for past El Paso inspection reports; the “target date” or “next inspection” language is usually included in the “Findings” or “Recommendations” section. |
| **VA Office of Inspector General – “Inspection Calendar” on the OIG’s internal portal** | If you have a VA employee or contractor login (e.g., myVA.gov ), you may be able to access an internal OIG portal that lists upcoming inspection assignments.  This portal is not publicly available, but VA staff can retrieve the schedule through their internal OIG liaison. |

**What to do next**

1. **Check the OIG website** – Start with the OIG’s public site to see if an “Upcoming Inspections” page exists.  
2. **Submit a FOIA request** – If the date is not publicly posted, a FOIA request is the most reliable way to obtain an official schedule.  
3. **Call or email the OIG** – A quick phone call to the OIG public liaison can often give you a direct answer or point you to the right contact.  
4. **Contact VISN‑19 or the El Paso facility** – Their quality‑ and safety‑oriented offices may already have the inspection calendar or can request it from the OIG on your behalf.  

These channels are the standard ways that VA facilities obtain or confirm their OIG inspection schedules, since the OIG’s public data‑dashboard does not list future inspection dates.
